items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I got the call in 1967 from Tommy Cotney. He asked me to come down and work at Blues Alley.

ctx.x: And I guess the opportunity of maybe redefining yourself into a jazz singer and doing maybe the kinds of things you've been doing now for the past ten years didn't present itself at that time?

Not really because I was expected to do the "Loch Lomand"/and "Molly Malone" which were very good to me. In fact, after I had been retired for about ten years, this is when I got the call in 1967 from Tommy Cotney. He asked me to come down and work at Blues Alley.
